a.lede: Helion now has another $225 million to help speed development of its first fusion power plant, due to provide Microsoft with electricity in 2028.
a.title: Fusion startup Helion is developing new semiconductors that could double output of its power plants

b.lede: Top-funded fusion startup Commonwealth Fusion Systems received an $85 million award from the federal government to advance conductors for fusion power plants.
b.title: Commonwealth Fusion Systems gets $85M to build better fusion-ready semiconductors
